name: Regulatory decisions
definition: Approvals, complete response letters, advisory votes, designations, scheduling and rule-making by FDA, DEA, EMA, MHRA, TGA and state regulators for drugs and devices in psychiatry.

name: Trial outcomes
definition: Topline results, effect sizes, publications and terminations of named clinical programs in interventional psychiatry and psychedelic medicine.

name: Company and market outcomes
definition: Acquisitions, financings, listings, bankruptcies, layoffs, launches, revenue and share-price thresholds for companies in the field.

name: Payer and policy
definition: Coverage decisions, fee schedules, parity enforcement, telehealth rules, state programs and legislation that govern payment for and access to these treatments.

name: Practice adoption
definition: Measurable uptake in clinical practice: prescription volumes, device installations, clinic counts, guideline changes and workforce shifts.
